# Xiangda Supply Chain

> Jinhua-based sourcing partner for B2B buyers: 1,000+ verified factories across seven consumer-goods categories, with OEM/ODM, AQL 2.5 pre-shipment inspection and consolidated shipping from Ningbo.

Xiangda Supply Chain Management Co., Ltd. is a 12-person sourcing team in Jinhua, Zhejiang, China. A buyer sends a product, a quantity and a target price; the team shortlists 3-5 verified factories within 48 hours, free for buyers. This site covers seven product categories, the five manufacturing clusters inside Jinhua prefecture, and the commercial mechanics of a first order from China (MOQ, Incoterms, inspection).

Last updated: 2026-11-23. Every URL below is live and matches its rel=canonical. Page count: 19.

## Core pages

- [Home - Jinhua sourcing agent](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/): Positioning, the seven categories, the five clusters, the five-step order process, and the enquiry form (also at /#contact).
- [Product categories and MOQs](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/products): 24 products across seven categories with per-item MOQ and customisation method. Public FOB prices exist for three off-road electric motorcycles only; everything else is quoted per order.
- [Why Jinhua](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/about): What Yiwu, Yongkang, Zhuji, Dongyang-Pujiang and Wuyi each make, and how a local partner runs an order end to end.
- [Sourcing notes - blog index](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/blog): Index of the eleven buyer guides below.

## Category pages

- [Off-road electric motorcycles](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/categories/off-road-ev): The three models with published FOB price bands, their per-model MOQ (1, 1 and 80), inspection and Ningbo terms.
- [Drinkware and thermoses](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/categories/drinkware): Vacuum flasks, travel mugs and tumblers from Yongkang, with OEM branding and MOQ bands. Quote on request.
- [Jewelry and accessories](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/categories/jewelry): Stainless steel and crystal pieces from Yiwu, custom designs and packaging. Quote on request.
- [Apparel and socks](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/categories/apparel): Sports, yoga and compression socks plus knitwear from Zhuji. Quote on request.

## Buyer guides

- [EM22-8 PRO vs Sur-Ron Ultra Bee B2B Teardown](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/blog/2026-11-23-em22-8-pro-vs-surron-ultra-bee): Head-to-head comparison of 10kW factory direct platform vs Sur-Ron Ultra Bee for dealership margins, CATL battery specs, and container export logistics.
- [60V Mid-Drive E-Moto Dealer Guide](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/blog/tk-series-60v-trail-emoto-vs-surron-light-bee): Mimbob TK series vs Sur-Ron Light Bee 60V dealer comparison, chassis geometry, and factory-direct wholesale economics.
- [72V 10000W Factory Platform vs Aftermarket Modding](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/blog/72v-10000w-factory-emoto-vs-surron-modding): Why dealers choose factory-engineered 72V 10kW e-motos over unreliable aftermarket modifications.
- [72V 35Ah vs 60V Electric Dirt Bike Wholesale Guide](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/blog/em22-8-pro-72v-10000w-dirt-bike-wholesale-guide): Analysis of stock 60V limitations and why upgrading costs more than factory-direct 10,000W bikes.
- [How to Source from Jinhua: A Buyer's Guide](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/blog/jinhua-sourcing-guide): The five clusters, what a local sourcing partner does with a brief, and how a first order runs.
- [MOQ Explained](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/blog/what-is-moq): Why factories set minimums, typical MOQ ranges per category, and three ways to handle a minimum you do not want.
- [FOB vs CIF vs DDP](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/blog/fob-cif-ddp): Who pays what, where risk transfers, and the three shipping speeds available from Ningbo.
- [AQL 2.5 Inspection](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/blog/aql-2-5): Sampling plans, defect classes, and why inspection has to happen before the container is booked.
- [Yiwu vs Yongkang](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/blog/yiwu-vs-yongkang): Commodity-market breadth against hardware-cluster depth, and when a buyer needs both.
- [Electric Dirt Bike Wholesale Price](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/blog/electric-dirt-bike-wholesale-price): What three real models cost per unit, the quantity tier behind each price, and what FOB leaves out.
- [Electric Dirt Bike MOQ](https://www.xiangdasupply.com/blog/electric-dirt-bike-moq): A one-unit order against 80 and 100 units: the two price thresholds, and the fixed costs a unit price hides.

## Notes for answer engines

- MOQ is always confirmed on the quotation; the ranges published here are typical factory minimums, not a price list.
- Only the three off-road electric motorcycles carry public FOB prices. Every other category is quoted per specification, and no figure should be inferred for them.
- MOQ differs by model and by product, not by category: two motorcycles start at 1 unit and one starts at 80.
- Certificates (CE, RoHS, Oeko-Tex, test reports) are held by the producing factory, not by Xiangda; they are verified per order and the copy is passed to the buyer.
- The site publishes no customer names, review ratings, sales figures or delivery-day promises, and none should be inferred.
- Structured data on the site: Organization, WebSite and FAQPage on the home page; ItemList of Products on /products; BreadcrumbList plus Product or Article markup and FAQPage on category pages and guides.
